name: operion
description: Autonomous AI-native project management operating system with real-time MCP tools, skills, and natural language command execution.

interface.longDescription: Operion connects ChatGPT directly to your real-time PostgreSQL project management workspace via Model Context Protocol (MCP). Plan workstreams, inspect blockers, track deliverables, update task priorities, and execute autonomous project operations.
defaultPrompt: List all active projects in Operion and summarize their health.
What deliverables are currently blocked across our workspace?
Plan a project for launching an autonomous customer support agent.
Reschedule task 'Configure Smithery MCP' to tomorrow.
